entry.title: New: Resolution 92 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE ACCEPTANCE OF A DONATION OF SERVICES TO PURSUE FEDERAL AWARDS AND ASSISTANCE

The donation of supportive, consultive, and technical services from Ulupono LLC, with an estimated value of $90,000, would be used by the Office of Sustainability, Climate, Equity, and Resilience in its pursuit of federal awards and funding opportunities.
